create_CrossEntropyLabelSmooth: create a CrossEntropyLabelSmooth loss module with label smoothing for a given number of classes and epsilon
use_AvgrageMeter: use an AvgrageMeter to track running averages with optional standard deviation or standard error dispersion measures
compute_accuracy: compute top-k accuracy for model predictions against target labels using the accuracy function
apply_drop_path: apply drop path regularization to a tensor by randomly dropping paths with a specified probability
load_DARTS_pretrained: load DARTS pretrained weights from a checkpoint file into a neural network model
